app.languageDesc: Choose the interface language. Applies immediately.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.desc: Six themes, all borrowing their kanji from Japanese color names. Changes apply immediately.

onboarding.title: Replay onboarding
onboarding.desc: Walk through the first-run wizard again to re-pick defaults. Your current settings are preserved until you finish the wizard.

ffmpeg.title: FFmpeg engine
ffmpeg.desc: MoeKoder bundles ffmpeg + ffprobe under your user data directory. Reinstall if the binaries look damaged or you want a fresh copy.

logs.title: Logs
logs.desc: Open the log folder in your file manager. Useful when filing an issue — zip the folder and attach it.

encoding.title: Encoding
encoding.desc: Codec, hardware encoder, and quality knobs for every encode the app starts. Quick-set Fast/Balanced/Pristine for sane defaults; tune CQ + presets for fine control.

codec.label: Codec
codec.hint: H.264 is the broadest compat. HEVC saves ~40% size, AV1 ~50%.

hwEncoder.label: Encoder
hwEncoder.hint: Hardware encoders are faster; software encoders give finer quality control. NVENC options disable when your GPU doesn't advertise the encoder.

tier.label: Quality tier
tier.hint: One-click presets per codec. Fast = preview-grade, Balanced = anime-archival default, Pristine = max quality.

cq.label: Quality (CQ)
cq.hint: Lower = better. Range {{min}}–{{max}} for the current encoder.

nvencPreset.label: NVENC preset
nvencPreset.hint: Higher numbers = slower + better quality. Anime archival sweet spot is p4–p7.

libx265Preset.label: libx265 preset
libx265Preset.hint: Slower presets give finer compression at the cost of encode time.

svtPreset.label: SVT-AV1 preset
svtPreset.hint: 0 = highest quality / slowest, 13 = fastest. Anime archival lands at 4–8.

tenBit.label: 10-bit (main10) output
tenBit.desc: HEVC + AV1 main10 encodes hold up better in dark scenes. Slightly slower; widely supported on modern players.

container.label: Container
container.hint: MP4 plays everywhere; MKV preserves the full feature set + supports any audio codec stream-copied.

mux.label: Mux only (soft subs)
mux.desc: Don't burn — stream-copy the video + audio and add the subtitle as a separate, selectable track. Finishes in seconds (no re-encode). Forces the MKV container; codec + quality settings above are ignored while this is on.
mux.trackLangHint: ISO-639-2 code (eng, pol, jpn) the player labels the track with. Leave blank to auto-derive from the subtitle filename suffix (e.g. <0>.en.ass</0> → eng).
mux.mp4Warning: MP4 can't carry soft <0>.ass</0> subtitles — output will be written as MKV.

benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.desc: Encode a 10-second sample against three candidate profiles and compare size + time + PSNR side-by-side. Results stay in this session.

hw.noAv1Nvenc: AV1 NVENC requires an RTX 40-series GPU
hw.noHevcNvenc: HEVC NVENC not available on this GPU

fonts.title: Embedded fonts
fonts.desc: When the source is an MKV with attached fonts (the fansub default), MoeKoder extracts them into a per-job temp dir and feeds the path to libass so \fn(CustomFont) typesetting renders as the author intended. Off ⇒ libass falls back to system fonts only, matching v0.4 behaviour.
fonts.checkboxDesc: On by default. Cleans up after every encode — no fonts are left on disk. Toggle off if you'd rather every typeset cue render in Arial.

queue.title: Queue
queue.desc: Knobs for the batch pipeline. Concurrency mirrors the segmented control on the Queue screen — both write to electron-store, so changes from either side stick.

concurrency.label: Concurrency
concurrency.hint: How many encodes run in parallel. Mirrors the Queue screen control. Default 1 keeps the Single route's one-encode-at-a-time guarantee untouched.

maxRetries.label: Max retries
maxRetries.hint: How many times a failed item retries before it gives up. Total attempts = {{totalAttempts}}.

backoff.label: Retry backoff
backoff.hint: Wait between retry attempts. Doubles each retry: {{a}}s → {{b}}s → {{c}}s…

notify.label: Notify when queue finishes
notify.desc: Show a desktop notification when the queue drains so you can walk away and still know when to come back.

defaultRoute.label: Default screen on launch
defaultRoute.hint: Which tab Moekoder opens on launch. Pick Queue if you mostly batch.

updates.title: Updates
updates.desc: MoeKoder never phones home unless you click Check — that's the pledge. Opt in below if you'd rather the app check in the background (once 5 s after launch, then hourly).

autoCheck.label: Check for updates automatically
autoCheck.desc: Off by default. When on, MoeKoder queries GitHub Releases on launch + once per hour. Updates are never installed without your click.

about.title: About MoeKoder
about.desc: Version, build, credits, and links to the rest of the Shiro Suite.

presets.title: Custom presets
presets.desc: Save the current encoding profile under a name and apply it later in one click. Up to 20 presets; names must be unique. Survives app restart.

saveForm.label: Save current as preset
saveForm.desc: Captures whatever's set in the Encoding section above. Survives an app restart.

tooltip.nameClash: A preset with that name already exists

benchmark.title: Benchmark candidates
benchmark.body: Encodes a 10-second sample of the chosen video against each candidate, then measures output size, encode time, and PSNR. Pick a representative scene — solid colour transitions or fast motion expose differences best.
